architecture: learned word-attention encoder plus character GRU decoder
training_method: learned input word attention; first 12 reply characters weighted 12x; surface-form augmentation; 6000 focused steps
limitations: Single-message, small-domain experimental LM; keyword matches are not a general intelligence benchmark.
weight_format: per-row symmetric int8 weights; float32 row scales and biases; int16 recurrent dot-product activations
